scope: Six pages of open and closed issues; focused review of 21 relevant reports and maintainer comments. This is not an exhaustive audit of all Splide issues.

baseline.scope: Initial 16-case regression probe, before the fixes and additional guard cases.

entries.title: Prevent onResize method triggering on scroll event
entries.finding: Height-only resize reset both a pending transition and an active drag. Preserve the current visual position when viewport width and options have not changed.

entries.title: Disabled drag feature is still moving the slider
entries.finding: Disabling drag during a pending or active gesture did not cancel it. Explicit cancellation now restores the position and releases mouse capture.

entries.title: Blocked aria-hidden on an element because its descendant retained focus
entries.finding: Focus could remain in a newly hidden slide. Clear the old focus before aria-hidden and focus the current slide when slideFocus is enabled. Autoplay stays paused during active drag.

entries.title: use transform: scale width error
entries.finding: Logical positions use untransformed CSS layout widths. Ancestor scale is still used to normalize screen-space pointer distance and momentum.

entries.title: container display:flex overflow slider
entries.finding: The carousel could force a flex/grid column beyond its available width. Add min-width:0 to the carousel root.

entries.title: Keyboard
entries.finding: Disabling the focused end arrow lost focused keyboard navigation. Transfer focus to the enabled opposite arrow.

entries.title: Focus center with trimspace false not working correctly when showing slider on click
entries.finding: Opening a native dialog correctly recalculates centered geometry via ResizeObserver.

entries.title: Link focus issue on "destroyed" slider
entries.finding: Destroy breakpoint restores descendant links to the tab order.

entries.title: Destroy does not remove `tabindex="-1"` from all items causing an accessibility issue
entries.finding: Author tabindex and ARIA are restored on destroy, including the responsive destroy path.

entries.title: Drag with mouse sometimes not working correct when mousebutton released above arrows
entries.finding: Window pointer listeners and capture release prevent a sticky drag when the mouse is released over an arrow.

entries.title: Wrong width of next slide when using padding and gap
entries.finding: Initial loop geometry with padding and gap stays identical after refresh.

entries.title: Vertical page scroll blocked after horizontal drag on mobile (v4)
entries.finding: Native mobile Chromium verifies vertical page scrolling after repeated horizontal gestures. This is not proof for physical iOS Safari.

entries.title: Touch switching is not possible on mobile devices on Shopify
entries.finding: Repeated native touch swipes work in the local multiple-slide demo. The Shopify theme and its CSS are not reproduced.

entries.title: Problem with autoWidth and breakpoints
entries.finding: autoWidth remains readonly while mounted. Direct changes and differing breakpoint values raise explicit errors; failed options updates roll back atomically. After destroy, modes may be changed and mounted again.

entries.title: Arrows become disabled in "loop" type slide instead of looping and shifting clones
entries.finding: type remains readonly while mounted. Direct changes and differing breakpoint values raise explicit errors; failed options updates roll back atomically. After destroy, modes may be changed and mounted again.

entries.title: Bugs when using focus, type loop together
entries.finding: Fractional positive perPage and Infinity are rejected before DOM changes. Numeric strings are normalized. Fractional flickMaxPages creates an integer clone buffer, and changes to flickMaxPages/clones rebuild that buffer.

entries.title: "loop" and checkbox
entries.finding: Clone descendants receive unique IDs and local IDREF/fragment/SVG references. Form values, checkbox/radio state, select selections and files synchronize with originals on input/change and before navigation. Clones are excluded from the enclosing original form. Native reset is synchronized; original IDs and edited values survive destroy. JavaScript listeners are not cloned: use event delegation.

steps: click the label in original slide 2

entries.title: When scale up it's showing a little right glitch when click on next
entries.finding: Logical offsets use fractional computed layout widths rather than transformed bounding rectangles. CSS scale/translate applied to the active slide no longer corrupt navigation stride.

entries.title: Slide does not loop naturally when using autoWidth option
entries.finding: Variable-width loop coverage is tested; physical-device animation smoothness and every upstream reproduction are not certified.

entries.title: pauseOnFocus / pauseOnHover does not work
entries.finding: This report concerns Svelte AutoScroll extension options. nano-swipe has interval autoplay, without Svelte or the AutoScroll extension.

entries.title: Empty spae/gap after refresh and moving slider
entries.finding: This report uses vertical direction and free drag in a React wrapper. Those features are not part of the supported nano-swipe contract.

verification.package: ESM, CommonJS, browser, CSS and gzip passed

docs.note: Native touch injection is Chromium-only; three non-mobile project instances skip that test.

previous_verification.package: ESM, CommonJS, browser, CSS and gzip passed

follow_up.additional_fix: Updating flickMaxPages or clones rebuilds the integer loop buffer.
